description: §66.12.6 rule 3: a removal's value is `T | not` (`not` on an empty tape), so `const last: int = xs.pop()` puts an `int | not` into an `int` — E-TYPE-031 (ruled S442: "`T | not` into `T` is an error for all types"). Narrow it first (`if (v is given)`).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — tape methods are named after their grants; JS array method names are refused" ("Names match the grants (Recommended)")
rationale: §66.12.6 rule 3: "`pop`, `shift` and `remove` return the removed value, typed `T | not`"; a `T | not` value into a `T` annotation is E-TYPE-031 (§34).
